ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, the line $AB$: $y=kx+b$ intersects with the linear function $y=2x$ at point $B$. What is the value of $k+b$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Substitute $x=1$ into $y=2x$, to get $y=2\times1=2$,\\
$\therefore B(1,2)$,\\
Substitute $x=1$, $y=2$ into $y=kx+b$, we get: $k+b=\boxed{2}$
